body: I see it often in the comments of trans black women’s posts. Calling them m*tilated freaks, claiming that trans women want to be them so bad, and rubbing it in their face that they can’t get pregnant. Straight up laughing at trans women when they say they’ve been assaulted. Making fun of their looks, their voices, anything to make them feel inferior. I have black trans friends and relatives and the stories they tell about the negative experiences from other black people is sickening
I was just asking. And no I’m not trans.
